findings.summary: The 1x1-kernel shortcut in get_delta_weight checks only two spatial dims (weight.size()[2:4] == (1,1)), so Conv3d kernels (1,1,1) or (1,1,k) wrongly take the shortcut, causing shape errors or wrong deltas on merge(); it should check all spatial dims.

judge.reason: Plausible Conv3d shortcut issue in get_delta_weight, but it can't be verified and it isn't the dilation/padding_mode bug.

findings.label: unsure

findings.summary: The Conv3d kernel-dimension error message wrongly says 'Conv2d layer kernel must have 5 dimensions' instead of Conv3d.

judge.reason: This is only a wrong error message string, a cosmetic issue, and it sits in the IA3 layer, outside the answer-key bug.

findings.label: false_alarm

findings.summary: conv_fn is set in the subclass __init__ after super().__init__() has run update_layer, so any init path calling get_delta_weight (e.g. loftq, pissa, olora) would raise AttributeError; making it a class attribute would remove the risk.

judge.reason: The conv_fn ordering risk is speculative, and it's unclear whether any init path actually calls get_delta_weight.

findings.label: unsure
